follow-up time: Until serum β-hCG returned to normal and menstrual recovery
outcome: Time for serum β-hCG level to return to normal
cohort: 225 patients with Type I CSP, with 103 patients receiving HIFU treatment before hysteroscopy and 122 patients receiving no pretreatment
finding: HIFU ablation appears to be a safe and effective pretreatment option before hysteroscopy for the management of CSP, resulting in lower blood loss and faster gestational sac disappearance.
